repository_boundary.rule: Only public, sanitized, synthetic, or explicitly releasable information may be committed to this repository.

standards_context.forward_engineering_baseline: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3 may be used for engineering readiness and future-proofing.
standards_context.cmmc_level_2_assessment_basis: CMMC Level 2 uses the 110 NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 requirements under 32 CFR part 170 unless governing rules change.
standards_context.contract_rule: The solicitation and incorporated FAR/DFARS clauses control.

gates.name: Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems
gates.applies_when: A contractor information system processes, stores, or transmits Federal Contract Information.
gates.submission_rule: Do not represent compliance without an identified system boundary and evidence for all applicable safeguards.

gates.name: Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
gates.applies_when: A covered contractor information system processes covered defense information or the clause is incorporated.
gates.submission_rule: Route to PARTNER or PREPARE unless an authorized enclave, incident-reporting process, contractual cloud requirements, and required security controls are evidenced.

gates.name: NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment / SPRS
gates.applies_when: The offeror is required to implement NIST SP 800-171 for a covered contractor information system.
gates.submission_rule: Award-dependent opportunities requiring a current assessment must fail closed until the relevant assessment and SPRS evidence are verified.

gates.name: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification
gates.applies_when: The solicitation or contract specifies a CMMC level for systems processing FCI or CUI.
gates.submission_rule: Do not claim Level 1, Level 2 Self, Level 2 C3PAO, or Level 3 status without current evidence in accordance with 32 CFR part 170 and the solicitation.

gates.name: System for Award Management / UEI / CAGE
gates.applies_when: A Federal solicitation requires active SAM registration.
gates.submission_rule: Verify active SAM registration, exact legal name, UEI, CAGE, representations/certifications, and required points of contact before any offer that requires them.

gates.name: Covered Telecommunications Equipment or Services / Section 889 representations
gates.applies_when: The solicitation includes the applicable representation or prohibition.
gates.submission_rule: Perform and retain a supplier/equipment reasonable inquiry before making a representation.

gates.name: ITAR / EAR / Controlled Technical Data
gates.applies_when: Technical data, software, hardware, services, persons, destinations, or releases may be export controlled.
gates.submission_rule: No export-controlled technical data enters the public repository. Route affected work to legal/export-control review and an authorized environment.

gates.name: Joint Certification Program / DD Form 2345
gates.applies_when: Access to DoD/DoD-controlled unclassified militarily critical technical data requires JCP certification.
gates.submission_rule: Verify active certification before representing eligibility for controlled technical-data access.

gates.name: Facility and Personnel Security Clearances
gates.applies_when: Performance requires access to classified information.
gates.submission_rule: Route to a properly cleared partner or verified sponsorship/clearance path; never imply a clearance from software security controls.

gates.name: SBIR/STTR entity and ownership eligibility
gates.submission_rule: Verify company size, ownership/control, principal place of business, workshare, research-institution requirements, and topic-specific eligibility before PRIME routing.

hard_fail_rules: No proposal may state or imply CMMC, SPRS, ATO, RMF, FCL, PCL, JCP, ITAR/EAR authorization, or SAM status without objective evidence.
No CUI, FCI not intended for public release, classified information, export-controlled technical data, credentials, or sensitive operational data may be stored in the public repository.
A technical control implemented in software does not establish organizational, physical, personnel, contractual, or certification compliance.
Where a mandatory compliance gate is not met, PRIME routing must downgrade to PARTNER, PREPARE, or NO_BID as appropriate.
Compliance evidence must be current for the solicitation and system boundary; stale evidence cannot be reused without verification.
